findings.fix: Decide whether React logic belongs in render, an event handler, a key reset, useSyncExternalStore or useEffect, and fix Effects that misbehave: missing or suppressed dependencies, asymmetric cleanup, Effect chains, state copied from props, stale or out-of-order fetch responses, Strict Mode double runs and once-per-app initialization. Use when writing, reviewing or testing a component that uses useEffect, useLayoutEffect or useEffectEvent, derived or reset state, or browser and store subscriptions, even when the user only says the UI flashes old data, runs twice in development, or shows a previous search's results. Not for data-library configuration (React Query, SWR), routing, Server Actions, reducers, or React questions with no Effect or derived state involved.

findings.fix: Add a short React Testing Library example to references/anti-patterns.md and load it when the task is writing tests.
